{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Re-read the data to ensure clean state
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Verify the number of sites
print('Unique sites:', df['site'].unique())

# Cross-tabulate site and arm to check balance
print('\nArm distribution by site:\n', pd.crosstab(df['site'], df['arm']))

# Check if arms are balanced across sites
# If not, raw response rate comparison may be confounded
arm_by_site = pd.crosstab(df['site'], df['arm'])
print('\nArm proportions by site:\n', arm_by_site.div(arm_by_site.sum(axis=1), axis=0))"}
